needs_atom.missing: When this enchantment enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.: MOVE_ZONE (and EXILE) take no duration role, so the 'until this enchantment leaves the battlefield' window cannot carry DurationUntilLeaves (which exists, wired only to GAIN_CONTROL / grants). Mapping the exile without it makes the exile permanent (stronger than printed); a separate leaves-the-battlefield return trigger is the old two-ability O-Ring wording and differs in timing edge cases. Needs MOVE_ZONE += duration (DurationUntilLeaves) with the executor returning the card to the battlefield under its owner's control. Flash keyword is compiled correctly; carrier SpellAbility(ENCHANTMENT) would also be needed.
